channel.title: Zig Guide Live blog
channel.description: Posts about Zig, each written against a named compiler.

item.title: The Check That Stopped Checking
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai
item.description: A comptime guard in a small library stopped working after a refactor, and no test failed. The fix is a build step that requires a compile error. Written against Zig 0.18.0-dev.246+05671ced9.

item.title: The File That Was Not There
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai
item.description: A short story about a passphrase tool that worked on one laptop and failed on all others. The fix is @embedFile and a word list that the compiler checks. Written against Zig 0.17.0-dev.2056+79a9897cd.

item.title: The 2 GB Log File at 11 PM
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai
item.description: A short story about an on-call engineer, a 2 GB log file, a server with no installs, and a 274 KB Zig program. Each program in it runs in your browser. Written against Zig 0.17.0-dev.2056+79a9897cd.

item.title: builtin.mode is deprecated: read builtin.optimize
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai
item.description: Zig master deprecated builtin.mode, builtin.cpu and builtin.os. This post shows what replaces each one, and how to examine your own compiler. Written against Zig 0.17.0-dev.2056+79a9897cd.
